newsitem.title: USA: In Home Health chief executive resigns.
newsitem.headline: In Home Health chief executive resigns.

text.p: In Home Health Inc said Thursday its chief executive and board member Mark Gildea has resigned.

The company said Wolfgang von Maack will assume the position of acting chief executive. Von Maack is a senior vice president at ManorCare Health Services Inc, a wholly owned subsidiary of Manor Care Inc. He has worked for Manor Care for nine years, the company said.
In Home Health said its board of directors has formed a search committee to recruit a successor to Gildea.
In Home Health provides health care services to clients of all ages in their homes.
